name: Petalo
official_context: A light-up discovery friend used with challenge cards and connected subworlds.
verified_facts: Petalo is a light-up discovery friend used with challenge cards and connected subworlds.
Petalo encourages observation of light in everyday environments.
Petalo teaches cause and effect, safety awareness, and clear scientific communication.

learning_materials.beginner: Petalo glows bright when you complete challenge cards to explore light around us!
learning_materials.intermediate: Petalo helps us observe how light reflects, travels, and creates cause-and-effect reactions.
learning_materials.advanced: Petalo combines photic observation with structured challenge protocols to analyze environmental light safety.
